about: Games (ALL_GAMES in public/assets/js/games.js, C-21) without a game.json (#1249). The games of GAMES paid theirs off; the games built in cup/games/ came in frozen when the check reached every game (D-542). A ratchet: public/assets/js/conformance.test.mjs lets it only shrink, so a new game is born with its game.json (node tools/generators/new-game.mjs).

games.conexiones: Built in cup/games/: the manifest's schema describes a game folder with its own rules.js, LOCALES and modes, and this game's engine, screen and texts live in La Copa (cup/games/, cup/rules.js); it gets its game.json when the schema covers the Cup-built games
